verdict.rationale: Tavily exposes search, extract (batches of up to 20 URLs), and crawl endpoints under one API and SDK. Its Research endpoint runs multiple searches, analyzes sources, and generates a detailed report, with mini/pro depth modes, async status retrieval, and streaming. The same tools are available to agents through the official MCP server and CLI. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the Research endpoint's synthesis quality (the only community mention describes users wrapping Tavily in their own CLI for deep-research tasks).
